# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: arithmetic (spec 6.2). Value-level: expression + env -> value.
# These pin the LANGUAGE, not the encoding — no opcode or stack fact appears here.

== addition
expr 1 + 2
want Num 3

== subtraction
expr 2 - 5
want Num -3

== multiplication
expr 3 * 4
want Num 12

== division
expr 10 / 4
want Num 2.5

== modulo
expr 10 % 3
want Num 1

== precedence product over sum
expr 2 + 3 * 4
want Num 14

== parentheses override precedence
expr (2 + 3) * 4
want Num 20

== unary minus
expr -(2 + 3)
want Num -5

== unary minus stacks
expr - -5
want Num 5

== division by zero is unknown
expr 7 / 0
want nil

== modulo by zero is unknown
expr 7 % 0
want nil

== unknown propagates through arithmetic
expr (1 / 0) + 1
want nil

== fractional arithmetic
expr 0.1 + 0.2
want Num 0.3

== a variable read
env setpoint: Num = 10
expr setpoint * 2 + 1
want Num 21

== two variables
env a: Num = 6
env b: Num = 7
expr a * b
want Num 42

== modulo keeps the sign of the left side
expr -7 % 3
want Num -1

== division works on the wire tier
tier wire
env rate: Num = 4
expr 1000 / rate
want Num 250
